name: Meta Ads
title:
Be the reason
they stop scrolling.
description: Reach the right people on Facebook and Instagram with a thoughtful mix of audience research, creative testing and campaigns built around your business goals.
fit: For brands ready to turn attention into enquiries, store visits or online sales.
seoTitle: Meta Ads Specialist | Facebook & Instagram Ads — Zainab Abdullah
intro: Facebook and Instagram advertising works best when the audience, offer and next step make sense together. Zainab Abdullah helps businesses plan and manage Meta ad campaigns with that complete customer journey in mind.
deliverables: Audience & offer research
Clarify who you want to reach, what they need and how your offer answers that need.
Campaign planning & setup
Map the campaign objective, account structure, audiences, placements and landing-page journey.
Creative & message testing
Develop ad angles and copy, coordinate creative direction and compare meaningful variations.
Measurement & refinement
Agree on relevant conversion events, review performance and use findings to guide the next test.
questions: Can you help with both Facebook and Instagram ads?
Yes. Meta campaign planning can cover Facebook and Instagram, with placements selected around your audience, creative and campaign objective.
Is advertising spend included in the service fee?
No. Media spend is paid to the advertising platform separately. Scope, management fees and the proposed media budget are agreed before work starts.

name: TikTok Ads
title:
Fit the feed.
Stand out anyway.
description: Connect with your audience through TikTok campaigns that feel at home in the feed. Start with a clear message, test different hooks and learn what earns attention.
fit: For brands with an offer that can come to life through short-form video.
seoTitle: TikTok Ads Specialist | Paid Social Campaigns — Zainab Abdullah
intro: TikTok advertising needs more than a resized ad. Zainab Abdullah helps businesses connect their offer with platform-appropriate creative, a clear campaign objective and a practical testing plan.
deliverables: Audience & creative research
Explore the audience, category conversations and creative approaches relevant to your offer.
Hooks & creative briefs
Shape opening hooks, messaging and short-form creative briefs for your existing or commissioned assets.
Campaign setup & testing
Organise audiences, campaign objectives and creative variations so tests answer a useful question.
Reporting & next steps
Review attention, traffic and conversion signals in context and identify the next creative or targeting test.
questions: Do I need video assets before starting?
Existing footage can help, but the first step is to review what you have. Creative direction, asset requirements and any production work are agreed as part of the scope.
Can TikTok work alongside Meta or Google Ads?
Yes. The channels can support different stages of the customer journey. The right mix depends on your audience, offer, available creative and budget.

name: Google Ads
title:
Show up when
intent is highest.
description: Meet customers at the moment they are searching for a solution. Bring search intent, relevant ads and a clear landing-page journey into one focused plan.
fit: For businesses that want to reach people actively looking for their products or services.
seoTitle: Google Ads Specialist | Search Advertising — Zainab Abdullah
intro: A useful search campaign connects a real customer need with a relevant offer. Zainab Abdullah helps businesses plan and manage Google Ads with clear keyword intent, focused ad copy and an understandable path to enquiry or purchase.
deliverables: Search intent & keyword research
Explore relevant searches, customer intent and exclusions to shape a focused campaign.
Campaign structure & ad copy
Build a clear account structure with messaging that matches the search and the destination page.
Landing-page & tracking review
Review the conversion path and agree on the measurement needed to evaluate enquiries or sales.
Ongoing review & reporting
Assess search terms, campaign performance and budget allocation, then prioritise practical improvements.
questions: Can you review an existing Google Ads account?
Yes. An account review can examine the campaign structure, search terms, ad messaging, landing pages and available measurement. The scope is agreed first.
Can you guarantee a number of leads?
No. Advertising outcomes depend on your offer, competition, budget, creative, website and other factors. Goals and measurement are agreed, but results are not guaranteed.

name: Content Marketing
short: Give your message a longer life
title:
More than a post.
A reason to care.
description: Give your audience something worth paying attention to. Build a content direction that connects your brand message, customer questions and paid campaigns.
fit: For businesses that need a more consistent message across organic content and paid media.
seoTitle: Content Marketing & Social Media Strategy — Zainab Abdullah
intro: Content should help people understand your offer and decide what to do next. Zainab Abdullah develops content direction that connects brand messaging, audience questions and the wider advertising strategy.
deliverables: Audience & message discovery
Clarify the questions, objections and motivations your content should address.
Content pillars & direction
Create a practical set of themes that keeps the message coherent without repeating the same post.
Planning & calendars
Turn themes into a usable content calendar, with format recommendations and clear objectives.
Paid & organic alignment
Connect content topics with campaign angles so your brand feels consistent across touchpoints.
questions: Can content marketing support my paid ads?
Yes. Organic content can explain your offer, answer questions and reinforce the messages people encounter in your ads.
Does this include photography or video production?
Production is not automatically included. The proposal identifies which strategy, writing, creative and production deliverables are part of the project.

name: Business Analysis
title:
Make the complex
make sense.
description: Turn scattered requirements and complicated processes into clear diagrams and documentation that your business and technical teams can actually use.
fit: For founders, operations teams and software teams that need a shared understanding before building or improving a system.
seoTitle: Business Analyst | UML, BPMN & Process Mapping — Zainab Abdullah
intro: With more than two years of business analysis experience, Zainab Abdullah helps teams turn business needs into clear process maps, workflows, architecture diagrams and technical documentation.
deliverables: Requirements & process discovery
Understand the business problem, stakeholders, current process and desired outcome.
UML, BPMN & swimlanes
Choose the diagram format that best explains the actors, handoffs, decisions and system behaviour.
Workflow & architecture diagrams
Document how work and information move between people, teams and systems.
Technical documentation & handover
Prepare structured documentation that supports shared understanding and implementation planning.
questions: Which diagrams can you create?
The scope can include UML diagrams, swimlanes, BPMN, process maps, workflows and architecture diagrams. The format depends on the problem and intended audience.
Can I hire you for business analysis without advertising?
Yes. Business analysis is a separate engagement. Choose it in the project form and describe the process, system or documentation you need help with.
